name: Corporate Shipping Airways
infotext: Welcome to the Head Office of Corporate Shipping Airways.My name is Steve Malcolm and i am the manager of Corporate Shipping Airways.

Corporate Shipping Airways was created by brave Freelancer pilots more than a decade ago, with the aim of establishing distribution relationships even in the darkest corners of space. At the moment, we have been able to build the main office in Coronado system and the intermediate warehouse in Omicron Delta system. We have been able to establish many business relationships with different nationalities who need our services again and again.

Our company is specialized in selling all kinds of mining products, mostly copper, which we also process ourselves and transport them everywhere across space.Our modest base upholds high quality standards and prioritise our customers satisfaction. We hope to build a trusting relationship where majority can find something to their liking and become loyal customers.

name: Ionic Industries
infotext: Ionic Industries houses the heavy industry operated by Ionic Incorporated in Shikoku. Its main manufactory is a smelter to process the abundant platinum ore found in neighboring Galileo, for use in Kishiro's market-leading electronic products. The station also operates a uranium centrifuge to refine MOX fuel for its own usage and export.
Use guest access password "shop" to access the logistics overview.

While the station’s docking is nominally open, few areas are open to public access and transfers to the station are heavily screened.

name: Coleraine Distribution Centre
infotext: With the ever-so-exuberant success of the Galway refinery in Dublin - Lisheen Logistics Depot - a conundrum befell the board of directors, in spite of the Anti-Terrorist Operation Area, it struggles to meet market demand. The two-birds-one-stone approach was to establish in New London a sister refinery to accomodate surplus ore that Lisheen could not process. Additionally, the refinery will double as a distribution centre for public export, satiating the famished demand for Galway Gold.

Coleraine Distribution Centre sits comfortably off the Dublin boreen, carefully placed to allure those seeking gold. Here, law-abiding customers may enter and purchase Galway Gold, which is harvested fresh every day off the Dublin fields and refined locally to be served in its resplendent quality. Galway Gold is branded with its very own decorated stamp, exclaiming "Protected Designation of Origin - Dublin, United Kingdom of Bretonia".

name: Cleveland Station
infotext: A Harborage class installation housing around 1,200 personnel, Cleveland Station was originally constructed in early 828 AS as a waystation for atmospheric shuttles to Bristol’s Camp Lakewood on Hallam. While the station still serves this role, it has since been moved to a better position to serve Bristol miners on-route to the Ralston Heavy Water field. The station has few organizations barred from docking, with the most recent of these being DSE for their aggressive actions in Galileo.

name: Omega Palace
infotext: Welcome to Omega Palace the Equipment and Trading Palace in the Omega Systems. Visit our EQUIPMENT STORE to buy CLOAKING DEVICES or EXOTIC WEAPONS

name: Plano Outpost
infotext: Welcome to Plano Outpost. Please securely stow all weapons before leaving the flight deck. This is a secure station.

Plano Outpost is a recently established Liberty Navy station in far orbit of Planet Houston. The station serves a wide variety of duties including ensuring the safe passage of prison convoys transiting the void between LPI Sugarland and the planet. It also hosts a dockyard of moderate capabilities, acting as an ancillary facility to Norfolk, taking lower priority orders, and when not serving the Liberty Navy, the dockyard is available for contract for civillian projects.

The station is additionally home to a Liberty Navy surplus dealer, "Armed and Defenseless", which sells obsolete materiel dating from as early as the Nomad Wars to corporations and other Liberty forces.
Administrator: Captain Julius Fox, Carrier Oriskany, Deputy Chief Supply Liason for the Reserve Fleet.

name: Diamant Station
infotext: Welcome to Diamant Station, this station belongs and is maintained by the Red Hessian revolutionary movement.

The station itself is open to all members of the Red Hessian movement, Red Hessian allies and supporters. Security is strict to ensure that no spies or enemies have the chance to sabotage the station. However, if you are a supporter and wish to gain access to the Diamant's docking facilities, contact us over the RHNet.
The Viewshop password is "Diamanten".

name: Arcetri Station
infotext: A Creator class of 800 Bristol employees, Arcetri Station serves in the mining and refining of Platinum from the nearby Raiden, as well as housing a growing manufacturing industry connected to Platinum. From ship parts to components for capital grade gear, and the Platinum itself, Arcetri also holds an informal market for more niche goods. Despite this, the station operates under Bristol’s open docking policies, halting access for its direct competitors in the Platinum trade, DSE and Samura.

name: Tawau Manufactory
infotext: Tawau Manufactory is a newly-established Crayter civillian installation constructed in orbit of Yuma. Its primary purpose is to produce ship interiors, using the hardworking hands of the Crayter people. Ship interiors will be for purchase by anyone meeting the vetting standards of the Crayter Republic.

name: Connacht Depot
infotext: "Graves was a slave cage, BMM - the master's whip, and the riches of Dublin - a lure to tempt the gullible into giving up their life's blood for the Kingdom's wealth. We, the sons and daughters of Free Dublin, have seen this. Thousands are crippled, thousands are no longer with us, and every day, more perish to sate the Crown's greed. We hate the old company, we hate the Crown, and now we take up the sword against them. We call on all citizens of Bretonia to join us or get out of our way."

Connacht Depot is an ore processing plant built by the Mollys of the Republican Provisional Assembly as part of their industrial buildup plan for the Dublin system. It is a local hub of industry and serves as a staging point for exporting gold to outsiders. The gold produced here lacks special BMM markings and is considered contraband by the authorities.

Constructed shortly before the destruction of Graves Station, Connacht was initially a disposable platform holding extra gold ore storage silos for wildcat mining ops that the Mollys are known to profit from. However, once Battleship Essex retreated and the Crown's presence in the system waned, the Mollys continued to expand Connacht with extra storage, refineries and living quarters for the crews needed to operate them.

In light of an impending counterattack by the Armed Forces, the station has been fortified, but remains primarily a civilian installation, overseeing operations in the gold fields and sheltering Molly mining ships in need of R&R.
Shop inventory view token is 'mollygold'.

name: Grootegeluk Depot
infotext: Assembled in orbit of Planet Tuvalu by a joint team of Core technicians and Kusari advisors, Grootegeluk Depot's main objective is the creation of large stocks of foodstuffs ahead of grand explansion plans within nearby systems and in the Colonies.

Its proximity to Planet Nauru, however, has also turned it into the "front store" for rare materials and technology captured in daring expeditions and raids throughout the Edge Worlds, with all available for purchase by those neutral or allied to The Core.

name: Saint Florent Shipping Facility

name: United Bank of Liberty
infotext: Administrator & CEO: Thomas J. Gage

The First National United Bank of Liberty was established a decade ago as a start-up intended to expand into hitherto untapped revenue streams for Interspace, primarily in the areas of banking, financial services, wealth management, and so on.

The bank itself is a former DSE mobile station, however, due to a shift toward more efficient Archon-class vessels, the station fell into disuse and decay. The base was purchased by Interspace, and every addition was bespoke by Interspace, anticipating the needs of hundreds of investors, commodity speculators, and the required infrastructure for exchanging billions of credits in securities, bonds and other financial products daily across the vast distances of space.
The Bank today is permanently moored in orbit of Planet Houston, intended as a center of financial commerce to bring prosperity to the otherwise destitute Texas system.

name: Impala Station
infotext: Welcome to Impala Station!

Impala is a start-up project made by two brothers, Loto and Kitsu together with several workers and contractors, in order to mine, ship, and process Platinum. We seek to make a profit and we are a civilian group that avoids conflict and is open to doing business with everyone. Thank you for docking, enjoy the stay!

The station is buying Platinum Ore for 185 credits per unit! It is also selling Platinum for 125 credits per unit, Avionics Systems for 10.000 credits per unit and Propulsion Systems for 12.500 credits per unit. Although we aren't a shipyard in the conventional sense, we do engage in shipbuilding, with a focus on civilian vessels, though our capabilities are not limited to that domain.

name: Kadesh Orbital City
infotext: Kadesh Orbital City was established in 828 A.S. in Palmyra orbit as a modular station as a temporary shelter for Phoenix Zoners per return from the Great Voyage, but by 830 A.S. it was apparent that the station could no longer handle the increased workload and the location was favorable and safe enough to invest resources for a larger project. The question of expanding the station became an urgent one, but the off-the-shelf modular offerings on the market did not fit the specific criteria.

Taking advantage of connections with corporations in core worlds, Phoenix acquired the most appropriate station design blueprints known to the Sirius as Zeus type from Deep Space Engineering and finalized the ready-made design together with Daumann Heavy Construction, taking into account its all settlers and corefleet needs. Construction boiled over and multiple transport ships from Rheinland and Gallia began arriving at the construction site.

As of 832 A.S, per finishing off core works and establishing new Kadesh Orbital City, for now it provides like core worlds comfort to its residents and safe environment. Kadesh has become a remarkable spot in a remote region, serving its original purpose for its settlers, acting as freeport for lone strangers and allies and as attraction for tourists all around Sirius and Gallia, serving like a true city-of-paradise in those edge world badlands.

In light of recent events - the siege of the city by the Nomads and the Freeport 9 crisis caused by the expansion of the Corsairs serious measures have been taken into account. Earlier homeships were moored to the station and were used as housing modules, now almost the entire population of homeships has descended to the Kadesh Orbital City and each of the Nephilim class vessels can be used in open combat. Analysts agreed that many Zoners would consider the city a safe harbor.

Thus the Orontes planet-side colony project was lifted from the archives, as Kadesh was built for a reason in the orbit of the planet Palmyra. The planet had previously been scanned for an atmosphere, a core, and various metals in its interior. But due to the high cost of building Kadesh Orbital City as Zeus type, it is not considered as affordable in the foreseeable future at its best.

Weekly mining ops are a common sight at the Tavern, so join in if you want to haul something new for a change, or try your hand at the steady copper extraction. And as always, don't forget to buy a round for the mining crews coming off-shift!

name: Ravenna Invicta
infotext: Ravenna Invicta was established in 829 A.S. by Caesar Salazar as Roma Invicta to serve as the capital of the Roman Praetorian Prefecture of Sirius. During this time the base served as a cultural exchange point.

After a short while, seeing that his curiosity about other cultures isn't appealing to the majority of the Corsairs, he gathered his subjects and left Sirius. More details on their exodus are unknown at this time.
Roma Invicta was entrusted to Ravenna Nagash, the Executor of Deterrence, and her Conclave decided to rename it Ravenna Invicta, in her honor, to symbolize her might.

name: Nameless Depot
infotext: A sloppily re-pressurized wreck of a station drifting lazily in Knossos' orbit. The original builders of the small depot are unknown, but it was taken over by a group of Junkers after the original installation was blown apart and repaired to what an edge worlds Junker might consider livable standards.

The depot is operated as an open port, though visitors can expect little to nothing in terms of amenities - the only real service on offer is access to the storage compartments for safekeeping of regional treasures.

With little attention paid to meet any semblance of safety standards in its restoration, as well as its openness to parties with existential hostility towards each other, the Nameless Depot can fairly be considered one of the most dangerous stations in Sirius to visit, and few decide to linger in its desolation.

name: Oblivion Forge
infotext: Oblivion Forge was founded in 835 AS, not by a corporation or faction, but by a collective of independent freelancers seeking a remote and secure location to establish a small outpost.

The freelancers, driven by a thirst of inovation and the potential of profit, began experimenting with the new materials, leading to breakthroughs in weapons technology and exotic equipment designs.

Ionic manufactures a variety of shipboard high-tech equipment, such as hyperspace tunneling devices and specialized armaments.

name: Riau Star City
infotext: Riau Star City is the home of the Kongsi Syndicate, a tight-knit group of insular radicals within the IMG who organize themselves non-hierarchically along anarcho-syndicalist lines.

The syndics (or "syndies", as outsiders often call them) are known to be reclusive, and distrust almost anyone who isn't also affiliated with the Guild -- with the notable exceptions of the IMG's traditional partners in Gateway and the ALG. Outliers exist, however, and the syndics are known to work with freelancers and other flexible parties when it suits them.

name: Lisheen Logistics Depot
infotext: Ever since the disastrous events that transpired in Dublin 831 AS, Bretonia has been struggling to maintain a steady flow of her shimmering gold. The undoing of Graves and the following cataclysm cascaded an unprecendented deluge to the Queen's Kingdom. Promptly, the amassed stockpiles were washing off the shelves, and BMM efforts were few and lethargic. This eventually gave spark to an audacious outfit, that spearheaded the daunting crusade of Dublin's reclamation in the Queen's name.

In June 834 AS, Galway Frontiers sets foot and plants its flag within system, an aspiring refinery that will siphon once more the gold fields. This would not go unnoticed, as the station held stalwart with its courageous miners and valiant Armed Forces fighting shoulder-to-shoulder against the infestation that wrought devastation upon Dublin. Forseeably, the hard-fought campaign was won and the facility prophecied its destiny, with Dublin's gold in hand.

Lisheen Logistics Depot is presently the first and only lawful refinery within the Dublin system, located conveniently outside of the Achill asteroid field. Due to the Anti-Terrorist Operation Area embargoing Dublin and its access-points, Lisheen currently permits entities which the embargo does not affect, as further notice, entities seeking access to Lisheen are advised to contact Galway Frontiers directly, spaceside or otherwise.

name: Benthall Station
infotext: Benthall Station was built by the Bamburgh Company in 836 AS. Serving as their first foray into modular construction, it serves as a testbed for projects to come. When the station is fully completed, it will act as the Bamburgh Company’s headquarters and cargo shipping platform. Plans are in motion to also add a passenger terminal, allowing space to be freed up at the ever busy Kensington Shipping Platform. No date has been set as of yet.

name: Freeport 26
infotext: Originally built in the Kepler system, Freeport 26 was hastily dismantled and towed to Galileo in early 833 AS, narrowly avoiding obliteration by dark matter storm. After its biodomes were reassembled, local Zoners upgraded the installation to produce other essential supplies. In 835 AS, a ZDF science team returned from an extended survey mission and purchased the station to research anomalous materials. They have hired contractors from the ZS Group to provide logistics and security services.
"Lots of new gear in stock, my friend. I don't know how Denton's guys even find this, but it's good stuff. Pay a visit to the equipment dealer, I'm sure you'll find something you like."

"I bought these fancy engines from a racing promoter in Provence. Said they can run on either Promethene, or MOX, which we have plenty of here. Have you ever been to Gallia? Weird place, but their vistas and their food are top-notch. It's a hell of a trip to get there through the Taus, though. And that's if the Gauls don't turn you away at their Jump Gate in Tau-23. If you're not the adventurous kind, do yourself a favor and go through the Alsace Passage in Rheinland instead."

"Platinum refinery's gone and good riddance, I say. Worked there for a while after the Kepler move, and it was nothing but headaches. Half the equipment was damaged goods from the evacuation - dark matter does terrible things to precision machinery. We'd get a batch running smooth, then something would break down and we'd lose a week's work. Bristol's got brand new gear, we got salvage. Simple as that. Sometimes you gotta know when you're beat."

"Ever notice how many shady types dock here asking about 'spare components' or 'backup arrays'? They don't mean parts for a freighter. People are moving heavy weapons through here, and the buyers are getting bolder. Some of the stuff comes from as far as the Sigmas, or at least that's what I heard from those drunk Zoners the other night. Guys were bragging about stealing rocket pods straight off Corsair weapon platforms. Sounds like bullshit to impress the ladies, but they swear it's true."

name: Elcano Manufacturing Complex

While the source of this technology remains undisclosed, NHI guarantees the quality and effectiveness of all equipment sold on this station.
New Horizon Industries does not guarantee the compatibility of equipment with Sirian or Gallic vessels, nor does the company hold any liability for direct or indirect damage caused by its products.
